properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] Azure Purview: Managed Identity Required
properties.description: Audits Azure Purview accounts that do not have a managed identity configured. FedRAMP High requires identification and authentication (IA-2). Managed Identity enables credential-free scanning of data sources and eliminates the need for stored credentials, reducing the attack surface for data governance operations.

metadata.description: Audit: Report Purview accounts without managed identity. Deny: Block deployment. Disabled: Do not evaluate.
